title: Managed Deployments
summary: Managed Deployments let you run Workflows without provisioning or operating your own worker infrastructure, so you can easily build and deploy AI automations.
whatsNew: Managed Deployments let you run Workflows without provisioning or operating your own worker infrastructure, so you can easily build and deploy AI automations. Push your code, set up a deployment, and Mistral will run the workers on Mistral Cloud. During Public Preview, managed deployments require a paid plan (Pay-as-you-go or Enterprise) and are subject to a quota. See the Managed Deployments documentation for quota details.
keyCapabilities: Run workers without infrastructure. Deploy Workflows from any public or private GitHub repository onto Mistral Cloud, which handles building, scaling, and lifecycle management.
Full lifecycle management. Create, update, stop, start, restart, redeploy, and delete deployments from AI Studio or the API.
Service Account authentication. Workers authenticate via service accounts instead of workspace API keys. Existing API-key deployments migrate automatically on next restart.
Hardened deployments. Create deployments with network egress blocked at build and runtime.
Logs in the UI. View build and worker logs for your deployment directly in AI Studio.
